description: Generate Azure RBAC role assignment Bicep. Looks up common roles by name; falls back to caller-provided GUID.

principalId.description: Object ID of the principal (managed identity, user, service principal)

roleName.description: Built-in role name (e.g. 'Storage Blob Data Reader') OR a custom role GUID

scope.description: Resource ID to scope the assignment to (RG, subscription, or specific resource)

scopeKind.description: rg | subscription | resource — only affects the output template structure

name: generate_rbac_assignment
